qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the pressure regulator to valve housing on 4HP-22 EH/4 HP-24EH/A5S 310Z transmissions?

What is the difference in torque specifications between A5S 300J and A5S 300U for solenoid valve to valve housing?
